audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart shows 'Skill' on all seven rows while the packet chart and the content layer agree: Malzahar wins levels 3 through 6, Anivia takes over from first item on.
audit.why: Anivia's pre-ult clear is slow and mana-hungry; Malzahar's E-W shove pins her. From Glacial Storm plus a mana item she out-clears him and her egg blunts the suppress. 52.94% WR over 1838 games.
audit.corrected: Chart rows 2-6 moved to match the content layer, ratings and whys rewritten with them.

audit.why: Spikes are accurate and complete: Malzahar owns 3-5 pre-Glacial-Storm, level 6 Grasp, then Anivia's 1st-item and late flips — all four spikes[] entries grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never says Flash Frost cancels Nether Grasp's channel (flagged missing interaction); tradeGood describes poking 'his shield off' — Anivia has no shield, that is Akshan-template bleed; breakdown.cooldowns has no digit; 21 fields misgender Anivia as he/him.
audit.why: Malzahar's R is a channel — any CC cancels it, and Anivia's Q is a 11/10/9/8/7s stun. Her E Frostbite (4s CD) only doubles after Q or a formed Glacial Storm, which defines the good/bad trade windows. Her R is effectively spammable (4/3/2s CD drain).
audit.corrected: See edits: channel-cancel warning in cooldowns, phases[4].why, loading and dontsFull; tradeGood rebuilt on the Frostbite-double condition; real cooldowns added; every pronoun corrected.
